## Decisions

- **Group messages into audience channels by role and group targets**: Mirrors team chat channels and keeps role-directed communications organized.
- **Display profile names and omit raw email addresses from UI**: Complies with C-08 / C-18 privacy rules where emails are resolved solely at delivery time by backend.
